method: Reviewed official admissions sources, canonical university IDs, append-only facts; no generated entry thresholds or acceptance predictions.
integration_rules: Insert sources and confirmed program/link before requirements. Preserve every existing requirement and cycle; deduplicate by stable UUID only.
Retain evidence.university_wide=false. These facts apply to named routes, populations, programmes or levels; they must not become university-wide IELTS filters.
Unknown publication/intake years remain null. year=2026/2027 only denotes an explicitly published cycle, not the check date.
A TOEFL legacy score is never automatically converted to the new 1–6 scale. Component and total SAT/ACT facts remain distinct.
Duolingo uses kind=other because the installed requirement enum does not include Duolingo; its scale and acceptance policy are retained in evidence.
limitations: This is a reviewed selection across nine institutions, not full international qualification equivalency coverage.
UCA and WIUT publish legacy TOEFL values without a current-scale mapping. Those values retain legacy labels and require date confirmation.
CUHK primary pages were available in the current search index but direct page fetch returned a gateway error; its primary language table and primary FAQ agree.
Groningen’s 2027–2028 policy is separate from February 2027 intake and the earlier 2026–2027 policy.
No standalone numerical ETH language floor was added because the public extracted page omitted its dynamically rendered certificate table.
